corpora.prose: Outer-sect disciple Shen Yan found a cracked black-jade token beneath the cold pool. Its old seal-script matched the fragment his master left three years ago. He did not claim it at once; he studied the flow of spiritual energy and found a trace of northern demonic breath inside the crack.
